projects.title: One model. Six markets. Room for the differences.
projects.description: A global business banking platform, followed by responsive standardisation and a programme of product evolution.
projects.outcome: The global platform, GEMA and Financial Health functionality were implemented and remain operational, as documented in September 2026. Across the wider BBVA relationship, I shared account-development responsibility with the account director; the account grew by almost 30% during that period.
projects.limits: The growth figure is a shared account result. Usage, conversion and efficiency metrics are not available. The six-market scope belongs to the global platform; GEMA’s exact geographic scope is not confirmed.

projects.title: Give fragmented knowledge a common entry point.
projects.description: An LLM-based internal MVP bringing four marketing programmes into one experience.
projects.outcome: An internal MVP and future-state experience were completed. The work demonstrated a common entry point to four programmes and a product direction for knowledge access.
projects.limits: The project was documented as work in progress in September 2026. Production deployment, adoption and efficiency gains are not confirmed. The degree of functional integration is not independently established here.

projects.title: A bank manager’s working day. A two-week brief.
projects.description: Research, product concept, ten screens and a navigable prototype for an AI-assisted manager tool.
projects.outcome: The package was delivered in less than two weeks. The project contributed to securing 40 of the 60 planned FTE for VML The Cocktail and opened the possibility of a design account with CaixaBank.
projects.limits: The FTE figure is a commercial team outcome, not a personal team size. Production deployment, user validation, adoption and operational gains are not confirmed.

projects.title: The brand promise has to reach the booking.
projects.description: An integrated direction for narrative, identity and the digital reservation experience.
projects.outcome: The identity and digital product package were delivered for implementation. The project was still in implementation when documented in September 2026.
projects.limits: Launch, conversion, usability and adoption results are not confirmed. Unreleased identity assets and interfaces are not included in this public narrative.

projects.title: The interface is part of the object.
projects.description: Five interaction concepts for a smart tap, shaped by hardware, wet hands and moments of limited attention.
projects.outcome: The concepts and prototypes were delivered for selection and validation. The product line was planned for 2027 when the work was documented in September 2026.
projects.limits: The final concept, workshop findings and launch are not confirmed. AI supported the design process; an AI capability in the final tap is not claimed.
